stories.headline: Democrats win a majority in both houses of Congress
stories.summary: Americans voted on 3 November in the midterm elections, with all 435 seats in the House of Representatives and 35 of the 100 Senate seats contested. By the following day the Democratic Party had won a majority in both houses of the incoming 120th Congress. It also took numerous other offices that Republicans had held.

stories.headline: Singapore raises its maximum haze fine tenfold
stories.summary: Singapore's parliament has amended the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act of 2014, a law that seeks to deter firms inside or outside Singapore from activities that contribute to haze over the city state. Maximum fines rise tenfold to S$20 million, about US$15 million. The amendments also introduce arrest powers and permit trials without the defendant present.

stories.headline: NASA's Swift observatory comes down after almost 22 years
stories.summary: NASA's Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory re-entered Earth's atmosphere on Wednesday, almost 22 years after launch. The US Space Force confirmed that it came down over the North Sumatra region of Indonesia. Swift launched in 2004 with three telescopes to study gamma-ray bursts, the most powerful explosions in the universe, and had been designed for a two-year prime mission.
